allow: PowerShell($v = ngrok version 2>&1 | Out-String; "VERSION: $v"; $c = ngrok config check 2>&1 | Out-String; "CONFIG: $c")

PowerShell(Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, StartTime, @{n='Mins';e={[math]::Round\(\(\(Get-Date\)-$_.StartTime\).TotalMinutes,1\)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize; "---PORT 3000---"; Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalPort, OwningProcess)
